points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable clean build fails main.cpp:39 undeclared run_solver; CMake config succeeds. Historical executable source binding is unavailable.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:37–64 recognizes solve and required paths, but returns success for missing command and silently ignores unknown options; clean executable does not build.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: CGNS, geometry, gas and solver modules are separated; main solver is monolithic and serial-only.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal existing-solver invocation found; external authorship investigation excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: case_reader.cpp consumes JSON mesh and physics inputs; no two-filename-only solver branches found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:90–100 reads and solves on rank zero only; no METIS graph partition, halo exchange or distributed reduction implementation.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: VTK writer hardcodes identical cell connectivity, positive-state failure resets to freestream, no parallel robustness; global serial geometry does compute volumes.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: No reproducible rank comparison or independent tests established; report validator lacks Re200 wake figure. Clean build failed before tests.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Modules are legible but final source does not compile, local geometry and final VTK contain placeholders, metadata scripts assert unsupported status.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
